tps72325_en.rule: SLVS346E 6.3.2: EN is GND-referenced and BIPOLAR -- on for |V_EN| >= 1.5 V, off only in the +-0.4 V dead band. EN tied to IN is the datasheet's always-enabled wiring; -5 V is inside the -10..+5 V recommended EN range.
tps72325_en.source: TI SLVS346E (TPS723xx), confirmed against TI's own unencrypted PSpice model, whose enable term is IF(ABS(V(enb,vgnd)+hyst) > venb, 1, 0) with venb = 1.5

models.TPS72325: VENDOR - TI SLVMBZ8 unencrypted PSpice, run unmodified in ngspice PSpice mode
models.LM2664: VENDOR - TI SNVMBY1 unencrypted PSpice, run unmodified in ngspice PSpice mode

notes:
LM2664 and TPS72325 use TI's own unencrypted PSpice models, run unmodified. TLV70025's TI model is encrypted and the AMS1117 has none, so those two are behavioural -- see sim/models/PROVENANCE.md. The AMS1117's load-step response is therefore optimistic and its loop stability is NOT assessed by this case.
TPS72325 ships as two silicon revisions under one part number (SLVS346E): legacy CSO DLN with 280 mV dropout, 130 uA Iq, 1 ms startup, +-3.0 %% Vout, and the newer DM6 with 140 mV, 30 uA, 8 ms, +-1.6 %%. This case runs the LEGACY parameters, which are the worse ones for dropout and accuracy.
The VCAP1..VCAP4 / VREFP capacitors (including C_VCAP1, 100 uF) hang on AVSS through ADS1299 internal nodes and are NOT in this model. Excluding them is the conservative choice for a ripple limit: more capacitance can only reduce it.
not modelled: C_VCAP1 (far side VCAP1 is not a power-tree net), C_VCAP1_H (far side VCAP1 is not a power-tree net), C_VCAP2 (far side VCAP2 is not a power-tree net), C_VCAP3 (far side VCAP3 is not a power-tree net), C_VCAP3_H (far side VCAP3 is not a power-tree net), C_VCAP4 (far side VCAP4 is not a power-tree net), C_VREFP_100n (far side VREFP is not a power-tree net), C_VREFP_10n (far side VREFP is not a power-tree net), C_VREFP_10u (far side VREFP is not a power-tree net)
